title: Sarcasm in Sight and Sound: Benchmarking and Expansion to Improve Multimodal Sarcasm Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification performance (macro-F1 and class-wise accuracies) across different specific categories of sarcasm (Propositional, Illocutionary, Embedded, Like-Prefixed) to quantify the impact of dataset class imbalance and subsequent distribution shifts.
